name: pi-boehsline
description: Boehsline ("bays-line"): the baseline for pi. Extensions, skills, prompts, and opinionated defaults in one package.
author: Eric Boehs
//peerDependenciesMeta: Optional so pi's git installer (a plain npm install in the clone) does not pull a copy of pi in behind it. pi supplies these at runtime; CI installs them only to typecheck.

pi.//: Explicit globs: lib/ holds imported modules, not extensions. Opt-in extensions are declared like the rest and gate themselves (lib/opt-in.ts), because pi settings filters can only narrow what a manifest declares. packages/* are git subtrees kept verbatim (so `git subtree pull` stays clean); list their entry files here instead of restructuring them.
